original_test_intent: Verify every in-scope PCIe card's BMC-reported name and status against the approved slot/card topology and same-host enumeration.
original_method: Bind the target BMC and PCIe topology, query the documented read-only PCIe records or UI, and correlate every Name/Status record with slot/function, expected device identity and OS link/driver evidence.
manual_activity: An operator may need to confirm slot labels or capture UI-only fields; collection and correlation can otherwise be automated after topology and schema are supplied.
required_inputs: Documented BMC PCIe endpoint or UI path
Expected device name and status per slot
Status rules for absent, disabled, link-down and training-failed
Protected credentials and same-host OS evidence
safety_requirements: Never reset, power-cycle, hot-plug, retrain or reconfigure PCIe devices
Associate every record to one slot/function
Reject cached, ambiguous or cross-host evidence
Stop on device disappearance or unexpected fault
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw BMC PCIe records or UI capture
Collect same-host PCI identity, driver and link state
Correlate each Name/Status to slot/function and approved inventory
Report discrepancies without changing device state or deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Supply vendor schema, topology and expected inventory
Confirm physical slot labels or UI-only evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: its DIMM-zone sensor assertions belong to duplicate row 769 and do not expose PCIe card identity or status.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented read-only BMC PCIe inventory plus same-host lspci/driver/link evidence with an approved slot/function mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Name, Status and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Store raw BMC and OS records and a slot/function-keyed identity/status comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic physical and OS correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every in-scope card remains required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC status vocabularies and slot labels may not map directly to OS bus addresses.

project_override_considerations: A project may define which empty, disabled or optional slots are in scope, but must record those decisions and may not substitute DIMM-temperature data for PCIe identity or health.
expected_evidence: Raw BMC PCIe endpoint response or UI capture
Same-host PCI identity, driver and link evidence
Topology comparison, preserved events and no-mutation proof

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1491 consistently defines PCIe card information; duplicate row 769 is isolated by variant and remains a DIMM thermal case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The topology, vendor schema and status semantics are finite package inputs; missing them requires confirmation rather than permanent blockage.

review_improvement: Removes duplicate-code DIMM-sensor contamination and requires every PCIe record to be bound to a physical slot/function and same-host enumeration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The read is non-destructive, but the proposed command targets the wrong case and cannot establish PCIe identity or state. Once the vendor schema and topology are supplied, deterministic collection is possible, so REQUIRES is correct.
